player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Kull indiċi għandu jkun bejn 0 u 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Il- micro_board, ir-ringiela jew il-kolonna huma barra mill-medda.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Il-plejer għandu jilgħab fil-bord mikro li jmiss.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} lagħab fuq micro board {macro_idx}, ċellula {micro_idx} (saf {row}, kolonna {col}). Player {opponent_id} irid issa jilgħab fuq {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Il-plejer {player_id} jirbaħ l-Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
